source_selection.rule: Lexicographic station-4946812 file path, physical CSV data-row order; first compatible PM2.5 rows, no synthesis

runtime_local_isolation: Use the fixed retained local_working_directory outside the repository. Only its bronze-checkpoint child is allowed; bind to this topic/table/query, and do not create a new working directory for reruns.

expected.same_cloud_rerun: No new source messages; all five table rows and snapshot-ID sets unchanged; compare within cloud, not against local snapshot IDs

athena.counts_sql:
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM "airlake_it2_20261106_f3b3b3e0677d4a6790e4a54faf68e4aa_bronze"."aq_measurements") AS bronze_count,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM "airlake_it2_20261106_f3b3b3e0677d4a6790e4a54faf68e4aa_silver"."aq_measurements") AS silver_count,
 (SELECT sum(value) FROM "airlake_it2_20261106_f3b3b3e0677d4a6790e4a54faf68e4aa_silver"."aq_measurements") AS pm25_sum,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM "airlake_it2_20261106_f3b3b3e0677d4a6790e4a54faf68e4aa_gold"."dim_location") AS dimension_count,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM "airlake_it2_20261106_f3b3b3e0677d4a6790e4a54faf68e4aa_gold"."pm25_aqi_hourly") AS hourly_count,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT location_id,hour_start FROM "airlake_it2_20261106_f3b3b3e0677d4a6790e4a54faf68e4aa_gold"."pm25_aqi_hourly" GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS duplicate_hourly_keys,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM "airlake_it2_20261106_f3b3b3e0677d4a6790e4a54faf68e4aa_gold"."pm25_aqi_hourly" h LEFT JOIN "airlake_it2_20261106_f3b3b3e0677d4a6790e4a54faf68e4aa_gold"."dim_location" d ON h.location_id=d.location_id WHERE d.location_id IS NULL) AS orphan_count
athena.hourly_sql: SELECT h.location_id,d.name,h.hour_start,h.pm25_avg,h.aqi FROM "airlake_it2_20261106_f3b3b3e0677d4a6790e4a54faf68e4aa_gold"."pm25_aqi_hourly" h JOIN "airlake_it2_20261106_f3b3b3e0677d4a6790e4a54faf68e4aa_gold"."dim_location" d ON h.location_id=d.location_id ORDER BY h.location_id,h.hour_start
record_after_execution: actual output locations and exact result-object keys

preflight_required: Fresh CLI and Java caller identity for account and Sydney region; no credentials printed
Expected bucket owner/region and complete empty run prefix; denial is not absence
All three exact Glue databases absent; only EntityNotFoundException proves absence
Workgroup enabled, effective engine 3, enforced results bucket unchanged
Frozen input SHA256 and Kafka partition-0 offsets exactly 0..199, no other partitions or new source records
Verified pinned JARs; existing airlake-spark credential_process profile unchanged
Separate explicit approval before the first AWS write
Exact persistent local checkpoint path has no symlink escape and is either new/empty or bound to this same query; preserve it on every outcome
operations_if_approved: Create three disposable namespaces and five Iceberg v2/Parquet tables
One available-now Bronze ingestion with retained local checkpoint, one Silver batch and one Gold batch
Verify actual rows/schema/UTC aggregation and snapshot metadata
Unchanged rerun under the same checkpoint without republishing, if included in approval
At most two narrowly scoped Athena SELECTs
cost_risks: S3 puts/gets/list/storage, Glue catalog actions/storage and Athena scan minima/results
The 10-GiB workgroup per-query cutoff is not a spending cap
No EC2, EMR, Glue ETL, ALB or Terraform provisioning required; Spark stays on the Mac
Regional rates and current IAM/SCP permissions have not been refreshed in this sprint
failure_recovery: Stop at the first failed or ambiguous cloud write; do not automatically retry or delete
Record each operation before submitting it, then table metadata/snapshot and exact S3 scope where readable
Retain any successful earlier commits; Bronze/Silver/Gold are not one atomic transaction
Preserve the local checkpoint and binding together. Stop on incompatibility; do not delete them, reset offsets or silently select a fresh checkpoint against existing cloud targets.
cleanup_not_executed: Inventory only this run prefix and these three exact databases/tables; review before deletion
After separate approval delete only five disposable table registrations and three namespaces; account for Glue archived table versions
Delete all enumerated Iceberg data/manifests/metadata objects only below this run prefix
Delete only actual result and ancillary keys recorded for the two new Athena query IDs; never clear the result bucket
If bucket versioning has changed, review versions/delete markers before deleting
Do not delete the previous integration-smoke prefix or production airlake_bronze/silver/gold resources
Retain the local checkpoint/binding/work directory until investigation and all approved reruns are finished; remove it only after separate explicit cleanup approval
selection_hash_definition: SHA256 of UTF-8 newline-joined json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False), in selection order with no final newline; not the generated gzip or selected-rows.json byte hash. Source-file hashes cover original compressed bytes.

local_checkpoint.policy: Retain both for matching reruns and partial-failure investigation; reject incompatible/unbound checkpoints and symlink escapes; never reset offsets
local_checkpoint.limitation: Local Mac checkpoint for this bounded test only; not production cloud fault tolerance

runtime_classpath.jsr305_duplicate_policy: Verify the cached artifact and the identical Spark-bundled JAR; load the bundled copy once, omitting the duplicate cache entry
runtime_classpath.checkpoint_filesystem: local file; no Hadoop S3A dependencies
